summary.text: Jay Bowman, an independent small-business owner who has lived in Kentucky since the mid-1990s, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Kentucky's 6th Congressional District to Zach Dembo.

paragraphs.text: Bowman says he was born in Michigan and raised in Utah, where his father's small-business success inspired him and his mother's pursuit of education instilled a love of learning. According to Ballotpedia, he was born in Grayling, Michigan, graduated from Olympus High School and has worked as an entrepreneur.
He says he started his own business at 24, moved to Kentucky in the mid-1990s, and has raised his family there as a small-business owner. He was on the 2026 general election ballot as an independent.
He campaigned on fiscal responsibility and a "10/10 Plan" to cut federal spending and reduce the deficit.
He received 2.5% of the vote to Zach Dembo's 52.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
